title: Contextual Relevance and Adaptive Sampling for LLM-Based Document Reranking
authors: Jerry Huang; Siddarth Madala; Cheng Niu; Julia Hockenmaier; Tong Zhang
why_relevant: Proposes uncertainty-aware Bayesian reranking with Thompson sampling, touching on calibration of relevance judgments and positional/context bias in LLM rerankers.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on reranking quality (nDCG) rather than robustness of RAG to noisy/adversarial/conflicting evidence; only tangentially relevant.
